2312.unvetted: cipher not shown: MAP XVII 211 re-viewed at the server maximum (IIIF 00100017/A0000427 recto 1364x1252, A0000428 verso 1358x1272, 1.25-3x crops, 6 Nov 2026). It is a full page of mercantesca on the recto and about 16 lines on the verso; the recto opens 'Spectabilis vir ...' in clear and the verso address reads 'Spectabili viro Fra[n]cesco ... oratori ... ' (rest not legible), so the hand is ordinary clear cursive; the odd groups (e.g. 'zyzz7te' on recto line 9) cannot be separated from abbreviations without a full palaeographic reading, and no run of symbol cipher or gloss is visible. The foot of the verso reads '... a dì 17 d(i) l[u]glio 1459' (the second digit is a looped merchant 4, the third a 5), not 1499: Piero di Lorenzo (born 1472) cannot be the sender, so the inventory's attribution is wrong (Piero di Cosimo, 1459, is the candidate). Lorenzo's Lettere do not reach 1459 and were not searched. Needs a full reading of the clear text to locate any cipher words before a verdict.
